newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to approve three-yr plan Friday.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to approve three-yr plan Friday.

text.p: The Italian government will approve a three-year economic plan, known as the DPEF, at a cabinet meeting on Friday, Deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni said.
"The DPEF will be approved on Friday at the cabinet meeting," Veltroni said in a speech at a conference organised by the employers' confederation Confindustria.
The three-year plan will set out tax and spending plans over the next three years and is expected to state that the government will seek to cut the public sector deficit by 25 trillion lire in 1998.
The most controversial part of the plan is related to the future of welfare and pensions spending which the government wants to curtail.
Veltroni said three-party negotiations involving the government, trade unions and employers would get under way as soon as the DPEF had been approved.
